notes.title: Customisable Cat Character!
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExdnhkMWsxNjZ5N3RkbzhmaWFkYXdyajh1YW1yazd4b2ltMXl5dnI0biZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/eWUwsQE22k5aecz4oJ/giphy.gif[/img]

Customize every detail of your cats! With the new update, you can now change the fur colors and eye colors of your cat characters. Enhance your character's uniqueness with a variety of eye colors. Our game offers you an unparalleled personalization experience. More options are waiting for you to define your cat's style and make it entirely your own
